title: Sources
intro: Upload papers and notes for the AI to answer from. Its answers cite the chunks they use.
accepted: PDF, Word (.docx), plain text or Markdown, up to {size} each.
viewerNotice: Only editors and owners can upload or remove sources.
duplicate: Already in this workspace as “{existing}”, so it was not processed again.
tooLargeHere: Larger than the {size} upload limit, so it was not sent.
emptyText: Uploaded files appear here while they are read, and are ready for the AI once they are.
permanent: Trying again will not help with this file.
deleteMessage: {name}, its chunks and the stored file will be removed. Answers that cited it will show the citation as unavailable.

viewer.title: {name} — source viewer
viewer.chunksHint: What the AI reads of this file, chunk by chunk. Text outside them is never sent to it.
viewer.noChunks: Nothing in this file could be indexed.
viewer.notReady: This source is still being read. Its chunks appear here once it is ready.
viewer.citationMissing: The cited chunk is no longer in this source: it has been read again since the answer was written.
viewer.unsupported: This kind of file cannot be shown here. Download it to open it on your computer.
viewer.pdfFailed: This PDF could not be shown here — it may be damaged or protected. Download it to open it on your computer.
